title: About Me
subTitle: I am a technology professional driven by a passion for transforming complex infrastructures into scalable, resilient platforms. My expertise spans legacy modernization, cloud-to-cloud migration, microservices architecture, and enterprise-scale application development. From gold retail systems at a government-owned enterprise to telco platforms powering millions of users, I design solutions that bridge business needs with technical excellence. Beyond engineering, I craft clear documentation that enables seamless vendor transitions and empowers teams to adopt new technologies with confidence. My work is guided by a commitment to reliability, clarity, and impact — building systems that not only function, but endure.

softskills.title: Softskills that pay the bills
softskills.copy: Beyond my technical expertise, I bring strong leadership, communication, time management, and task management skills — sharpened through my experience as a project leader responsible for coordinating not just my own work, but my entire team's deliverables. I don't just ship to production; I present changelogs and highlight critical development decisions to supervisors, ensuring full transparency and alignment. Outside of work, I enjoy reading novels and self-improvement books to keep my mind sharp, and running to stay physically energized and focused.

research.title: Research and planning
research.copy: One of my favorite aspects of engineering is planning the architecture of a system. Whether it's modernizing monolithic applications into microservices, designing cloud migration strategies, or identifying areas of improvement to support business growth — I thrive in analyzing complex requirements and translating them into scalable, well-structured solutions.
